text: 会议指出，近段时间一些地方生产安全事故多发，教训极为深刻。习近平总书记多次作出重要指示批示，我们要认真学习领会，坚决贯彻落实。要深入分析事故发生原因，举一反三，针对规章制度落实不严、工程层层转包、安全监管不到位等问题，采取有力措施切实加以解决。要严格属地管理，落实“三管三必须”要求，进一步压紧压实安全生产责任，紧盯重点行业领域深入开展风险隐患排查整治，强化常态化监管执法，严肃追责问责，坚决惩处安全生产违法违规行为，牢牢守住安全生产底线，有效遏制重特大事故发生，切实维护人民群众生命财产安全。
text_en: The meeting noted that in recent times, production safety accidents have occurred frequently in some regions, with extremely profound lessons. General Secretary Xi Jinping has made numerous important instructions and directives, which we must earnestly study and comprehend and resolutely implement. We must deeply analyze the causes of accidents, draw inferences from one case to others, and take effective measures to address problems such as lax implementation of rules and regulations, multi-layered subcontracting of projects, and inadequate safety supervision. We must strictly enforce territorial management, implement the "three musts for three areas" requirement, further consolidate and tighten production safety responsibilities, closely track key industries and sectors to carry out in-depth risk and hazard inspection and rectification, strengthen normalized regulatory enforcement, strictly pursue accountability, and resolutely punish illegal and non-compliant production safety acts, firmly hold the bottom line of production safety, effectively curb the occurrence of major and especially serious accidents, and earnestly safeguard the safety of people's lives and property.
